name: Taravangian
summary: King of Kharbranth and one of the most complex figures in the Cosmere. Cursed by the curse of the Diagram, Taravangian's intelligence fluctuates wildly: on some days he is a genius capable of predicting the future, on others a simple-minded child filled with compassion. He founded the Diagram—a secret organization dedicated to saving humanity by any means necessary—and orchestrated the deaths of countless innocents to position himself. In a stunning turn, he kills Odium's Vessel and Ascends to become the new Shard of Odium, wielding the power of Passion with an inscrutable plan.
